items.title: How many independent checks does it take to catch a wrong AI claim?
items.description: Ines's habit was one specific check against an independent source before she acted on the AI's honey claim — and it worked. Assume any single independent check has roughly a 65% chance of catching a genuinely wrong claim (it might not use the right source, or the source might be ambiguous). Drag the slider to see how the odds of catching a real error change as more independent checks are added — and notice how quickly the returns shrink after the first one or two.
items.compute: const perCheckCatchRate = 0.65; const errorsCaught = params.checks === 0 ? 0 : (1 - Math.pow(1 - perCheckCatchRate, params.checks)) * 100; return { errorsCaught: Math.round(errorsCaught * 10) / 10 };

outputs.label: Chance a genuine error gets caught
